title: An exception marker scopes to one field and then releases
summary: A restricted exception model makes one marker override the default value of exactly one selected field, after which later fields resume the inherited default.

design.unit: multi-field record containing a defaultable field before and after one exception marker
design.contrast: local override versus global mode switch
design.prediction: In matched records, only the selected field changes and the next eligible field returns to the default; a global mode would propagate the change.
design.countermodel: The same surface pattern could arise from a context-conditioned lexical convention or editorial packaging without the proposed semantic mechanism.
design.falsifier: The same marker changes every later eligible field, or changes an unselected earlier field, under fixed record layout.
design.principal_risk: Field selection and defaults are not independently meaning-bound. Near IDEA000034/042; retain as raw only if root judges the one-field release condition genuinely distinct.
